title: Affine localized Tor bound from the supported stalk
statement: Let f : X → Y be locally of finite type with Y Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f [def-pc-perfect-morphism]. Let U and V be affine opens of Y and X [def-pc-scheme] with V ⊆ f⁻¹(U), and g : R = Γ(Y,U)[t₁,...,tₙ] → B = Γ(X,V) surjective and compatible with f.appLE. For each prime p of R containing ker(g), put L = B localized as an R-module at p, with A = Γ(Y,U)-action through A → R → R_p. There exists d ∈ ℕ such that Tor_i^A(L,N) = 0 for every A-module N and i > d [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], with the first-variable Tor convention. No uniform bound in p is asserted.

proof.text: Install the base section-to-stalk algebra structure. IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk and IsLocalization.flat make the target stalk a flat A-algebra. Apply HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension at x to choose d valid for every module over the target stalk.

proof.text: For an arbitrary A-module N, extend N to the target stalk and apply its bound. Apply the flat-base restriction theorem, compose the affine comparison with restrictScalarsComp'App, and map this isomorphism through Tor' in its first argument. Transfer IsZero to obtain the bound for the original supported localized module.

theorem affinePolynomial_localized_finiteTorDimension_of_stalkwise_of_kernel_le
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hperfect : HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f)
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (n : ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U) →+* Γ(X, V))
    (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hcomp : g.comp (MvPolynomial.C) = (f.appLE U V e).hom)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker g ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U), ∀ i : ℕ, d < i →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, U)) i).obj
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U))
            (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl)).comp MvPolynomial.C)).obj
          (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars g).obj
            (ModuleCat.of Γ(X, V) Γ(X, V))).localizedModule
              p.asIdeal.primeCompl))).obj N)
